description: Seepage from the wounds of a warrior deity, sealed in an arcanist's orb following a campaign of vicious slaughter.
trivia: Corrosion's debuff does not have its own particle system and uses the particle effects of Thunder Clap's slow debuff instead.
recommendedFor: Also works very well on Abaddon, as it has very good synergy with his passive Curse of Avernus
Does really well when combined with Lifestealer's Ghoul Frenzy and Rage

notes: Armor reduction does not stack with its components, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.
abilities.description: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -2, slows their movement by -16% (-8% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by 18%. Lasts for 3 seconds.

name: Orb of Corrosion
